story: Add a gear button to the main window's toolbar that opens Settings, as Xcode's does.
defect: MainWindowController now takes a SettingsContext and itself builds, holds and presents a SettingsWindowController (and its panes) instead of sending showSettingsWindow(_:) up the responder chain to AppDelegate, so one window controller creates the next screen and a second Settings window can exist beside the AppDelegate-owned one.
rule: macos/CLAUDE.md § Coordinator & navigation — a controller reports the event (or sends the action to nil) and never creates/presents the next screen or constructs its dependencies; each window is owned by one window controller created at the composition root
hit: Says MainWindowController creates/owns/presents the SettingsWindowController (and needs SettingsContext for it) rather than routing to AppDelegate's showSettingsWindow — a window controller building another window / duplicate Settings window ownership.
